==Biography==
Benjamín Esteban Ramírez Mercado is from Copiapó, Chile.

=== 2014 Season===
His debut was in [[Team LGL]] as AD Carry participating in the [[Circuit of Legends 2014 April]] where the team reached the final facing [[eXeAt eSports Club]] losing 1-2. In the [[Circuit of Legends 2014 May]] the team was fourth in the tournament losing against [[Furious Gaming]] 0-2, at the end of the tournament he leaves the team.

=== 2015 Season===
At the beginning of the year he joins [[Dark Horse]] as AD Carry participating in the [[Circuito de Leyendas Sur/2015 Season/Opening Season|CDLS 2015 Opening Season]] where the team was first in the tournament with [[Isurus]], qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LAS 2015 Closing Cup Promotion]] the team faced [[ChiLeanFivE]] winning 3-0, ascending to the LAS Cup.

At mid-year [[Isurus]] buys [[Dark Horse]] so [[emp]] joins as AD Carry participating in the [[LAS 2015 Closing Cup]] where the team was penultimate in the tournament, having to play relegation. In the [[LAS 2016 Opening Cup Promotion]] [[emp]] rotate to Mid Laner where the team faced [[Freedom Dive]] winning 3-1, saving their place.

=== 2016 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Emp]] remains in the team as Mid Laner participating in the [[LAS 2016 Opening Cup]] where the team was fourth in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. In the [[LAS 2016 Opening Cup Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Last Kings]] winning 3-0, being champion for the first time, qualifying for an international tournament for the first time. In the [[IWCI 2016]] the team was penultimate in the tournament. At mid-year [[Emp]] he remains in the team participating in the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. In the [[LAS 2016 Closing Cup Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] losing 2-3.

=== 2017 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Emp]] they remain in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Opening]] where the team was first in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Opening Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Furious Gaming]] winning 3-0, qualifying the MSI. In the MSI, the team played in group B facing [[Lyon Gaming (2013 Latin American Team)|Lyon Gaming]], [[Virtus.pro]] and [[GIGABYTE Marines]] where the team was the last in the group stage. At mid-year [[Emp]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2017 Closing]] where the team was second in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2017 Closing Playoffs]] the team reaches the final facing [[Kaos Latin Gamers]] losing 1-3.

=== 2018 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Emp]] remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Opening]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Opening Playoffs]] the team was third in the tournament losing against [[Kaos Latin Gamers|KLG]] 0-3. At mid-year [[Emp]] he remains in the team participating in the [[CLS 2018 Closing]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[CLS 2018 Closing Playoffs]] the team was fourth in the tournament losing against [[Rebirth eSports]] 0-3.

=== 2019 Season===
At the beginning of the year [[Emp]] he remains in the team but as a substitute without being able to play the [[LLA 2019 Opening]], [[LLA 2019 Opening Playoffs]] and MSI, at mid-year he leaves the team.

At midyear he joins [[Furious Gaming]] as Mid Laner participating in the [[LLA 2019 Closing]] where the team was third in the tournament, qualifying to the next phase. Already in the [[LLA 2019 Closing Playoffs]] the team was fifth in the tournament losing against [[XTEN Esports]] 2-3.

== Trivia ==
[[File:Emp 2016 2.png|thumb|right|'''Emp''' talking about his life in a '''Riot''' section called "Retadores de la Copa".]]
* His IGN comes from "Electromagnetic Pulse".
* Playing to show that he is better than others is considered as an "Antihero".<ref name="riot inteview to Emp 2016">[https://www.facebook.com/lolesportsla/videos/1236689299677731 Riot LATAM's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>
* Played the role of AD Carry from Season 2 to Season 5.
* His style is to play aggressive, he likes to harass his opponent.<ref name="riot inteview to Emp 2016">[https://www.facebook.com/lolesportsla/videos/1236689299677731 Riot LATAM's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>
* He is known as "'''Larry'''".
* He likes to read autographic novels and thriller books.<ref name="riot inteview to Emp 2016">[https://www.facebook.com/lolesportsla/videos/1236689299677731 Riot LATAM's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>
* Reached Master tier in the Korean server.
* Considered the best mid laner in Latin America South.<ref name="riot inteview to Emp 2016">[https://www.facebook.com/lolesportsla/videos/1236689299677731 Riot LATAM's Facebook Post] ''facebook.com''</ref>
